brief.aim: The table was assembled to model total hourly bike rentals, so cnt is the numeric outcome regressed on calendar, weather and hour features; casual + registered sum exactly to cnt and instant is a row key, so both are excluded from features, and dteday orders one continuous hourly series for chronological splitting.
brief.repeated_subjects: none; each row is a distinct day-hour of a single continuous series
brief.unit: one hourly bike-rental period (an hour of a calendar day)
